[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | commonsalvage = 6-8 [[Granite Slab]]s }} The [[Stone Carving]] is a trophy dropped by [[stone guardian]]s in the Echovald Forest. ==Acquisition== * [[Factions]] ** [[Echovald Forest]] *** [[Craw Stonereap]] *** [[Mahr Stonebreaker]] *** [[Meril Stoneweaver]] *** [[Stone Crusher]] *** [[Stone Rain]] *** [[Stone Reaper]] *** [[Stone Soul]] *** [[Zarnas Stonewrath]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Stone Carving#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== {{section-stub}} Stone Carvings drop in the [[Echovald Forest]] in these areas: # [[Arborstone (explorable area)]] - heading left as you enter, 3 of the 4 bosses can be found relatively close to each other and have no other foes nearby. See [[Arborstone_(explorable_area)#Notes|the Notes section]] for how to spawn additional stone guardians. # [[Arborstone|Arborstone Mission]] # [[Morostav Trail]] - travel west along the south wall from Durheim Archives to find 3 groups of stone pillars that will collapse to reveal Stone elementals once you are within their area. This run takes 5 - 15 mins, depending on strategy, and encounters 12 Stone elementals. Killing all enemies along the route, including the boss and his group found directly next to the last group of Stone elementals nets 900 - 1000 faction per run. ==Collectors== {{:Master Architect Wright/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|29th June 2009 and 16th July 2012|Arborstone (explorable area)|1 [[Stone Carving]]}} == Trivia == * As revealed by Nicholas the Traveler, Stone Carvings are coveted for trading in Kryta. * The stone carving is the head of [[Stone Soul]]s.
